text: DRUG INTERACTIONS HIGH-DOSE CYCLOSPORIN A RESULTING IN CONCENTRATIONS ABOVE 2000 NG/ML ADMINISTERED WITH ORAL ETOPOSIDE HAS LED TO AN 80% INCREASE IN ETOPOSIDE EXPOSURE WITH A 38% DECREASE IN TOTAL BODY CLEARANCE OF ETOPOSIDE COMPARED TO ETOPOSIDE ALONE. CONTRAINDICATIONS ETOPOSIDE INJECTION IS CONTRAINDICATED IN PATIENTS WHO HAVE DEMONSTRATED A PREVIOUS HYPERSENSITIVITY TO ETOPOSIDE OR ANY COMPONENT OF THE FORMULATION.
